presets.name: Dino Suppression

presets.name: Dino Suppression
presets.notes: Temporary low-output 6-hour schedule intended to reduce pressure from Ostreopsis/Prorocentrum dinoflagellates while you address nutrients, UV/export, and competition. Disables Lunar/moonlight on push for full darkness overnight; re-enable Lunar manually after treatment. This is a short-term intervention preset, not a long-term schedule.

presets.name: Iridescence Viewing
presets.notes: Experimental K7 Mini viewing profile intended to bring out blue-green iridescence in fish while keeping enough white for natural body colour. Uses strong royal blue/blue with moderate white so livestock do not become a blue silhouette. Not PAR-tested; review the graph and start with reduced master brightness or acclimation if your corals are sensitive.
